description: This Java source file defines the MusicProvider class, which manages the retrieval, caching, and access of music metadata from a remote JSON catalog. It provides methods to get music genres, search tracks, fetch specific media metadata, and handle asynchronous loading from a server.

classes.name: MusicProvider
classes.description: A utility class that fetches, parses, and provides access to a list of music tracks from a server-side JSON catalog. Supports features like categorization by genre, search, and favorites management.

methods.name: getGenres
methods.description: Returns an iterable of available music genres if initialized; otherwise, an empty list.

methods.name: getMusicsByGenre
methods.description: Returns an iterable of MediaMetadata objects belonging to the specified genre.

methods.name: searchMusic
methods.description: Searches for tracks with titles containing the given query string.

methods.name: getMusic
methods.description: Retrieves the MediaMetadata for a given music ID.

methods.name: updateMusic
methods.description: Updates the metadata for a specific music track and rebuilds genre lists if needed.

methods.name: setFavorite
methods.description: Marks or unmarks a track as a favorite.

methods.name: isFavorite
methods.description: Checks if a track is marked as favorite.

methods.name: isInitialized
methods.description: Checks if the music catalog has been fully loaded and initialized.

methods.name: retrieveMediaAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves and caches the media catalog from the server, executing a callback upon completion.

methods.name: buildListsByGenre
methods.description: Rebuilds the genre-based grouping of media tracks.

methods.name: retrieveMedia
methods.description: Fetches the JSON catalog from the server, parses it, and populates internal data structures.

methods.name: buildFromJSON
methods.description: Creates a MediaMetadata object from a JSON object representing a track.

methods.name: fetchJSONFromUrl
methods.description: Fetches and parses a JSON object from a given URL.
